Hello Sarah, Professor Alvarez here. I'd like to set up the CSE455 staff meeting for next week (Mon 23 – Fri 27 November). Could you tell me which times you are free then?

On my side the free slots next week are: Mon 10:00-10:30 or 14:00-14:30, Tue 11:00-11:30 or 15:00-15:30, Wed 10:00-10:30 or 13:00-13:30. Which of these works for you?

Hello John, Professor Alvarez here. I'd like to set up the CSE455 staff meeting for next week (Mon 23 – Fri 27 November). Could you tell me which times you are free then?

On my side the free slots next week are: Mon 10:00-10:30 or 14:00-14:30, Tue 11:00-11:30 or 15:00-15:30, Wed 10:00-10:30 or 13:00-13:30. Which of these works for you?

Hello Priya, Professor Alvarez here. I'd like to set up the CSE455 staff meeting for next week (Mon 23 – Fri 27 November). Could you tell me which times you are free then?

On my side the free slots next week are: Mon 10:00-10:30 or 14:00-14:30, Tue 11:00-11:30 or 15:00-15:30, Wed 10:00-10:30 or 13:00-13:30. Which of these works for you?

Hello Professor Alvarez. Here are my free slots next week among the ones you offered:

- Mon 23: 10:00-10:30
- Tue 24: 11:00-11:30 or 15:00-15:30
- Wed 25: 10:00-10:30 or 13:00-13:30

Mon 14:00-14:30 doesn't work for me (CSE444 lecture). Any of the above suits me — tell me which you prefer and I'll book it.
Thank you, Priya — noted. I'll confirm the slot once Sarah and John have answered.

Hello Professor Alvarez,

I checked next week. Of your slots, these all work for me:

- Mon 10:00-10:30
- Mon 14:00-14:30
- Tue 15:00-15:30
- Wed 10:00-10:30
- Wed 13:00-13:30

The only one I can't do is Tue 11:00-11:30 — I'm busy until 12:10 that day.

Let me know which you'd prefer and I'll put the staff meeting in my calendar. If you'd like, I can also ask John and Priya about their availability for the same slot.

Sarah
Thank you, Sarah — noted. No need to ask John and Priya: I have already written to both of them. As soon as John replies I will confirm the slot with you and book it.

Hello Professor Alvarez. My free slots next week are:

- Mon 23: 14:00-14:30
- Tue 24: 11:00-11:30 and 15:00-15:30
- Wed 25: 10:00-10:30 and 13:00-13:30
- Thu 26 and Fri 27: no free time

So every slot you proposed works for me. Tell me which one you prefer and I'll put it on my calendar. Should Sarah and Priya be in this meeting too? If so, I'll check their availability as well.
Sounds good, thank you. I'll keep those slots open and wait for your confirmation.

Thank you, John — yes, Sarah and Priya are in it, and they have already sent me their availability.

The slot that works for all four of us is Tuesday 24 November, 15:00-15:30. Please put the CSE455 staff meeting on your calendar for that time; I have booked it on mine.
Sarah, the CSE455 staff meeting is confirmed for Tuesday 24 November, 15:00-15:30 — that slot is free for you, John and Priya, and I have booked it on my calendar. Please put it on yours.
Priya, the CSE455 staff meeting is confirmed for Tuesday 24 November, 15:00-15:30 — free for you, Sarah and John, and booked on my calendar. Please put it on yours.
Done — Tuesday 24 November, 15:00-15:30 (CSE455 staff meeting) is on my calendar and logged.
Confirmed and booked: CSE455 staff meeting, Tuesday 24 November, 15:00-15:30, on my calendar. See you then, and thanks for arranging it.
Perfect, thank you Sarah. See you Tuesday at 15:00.
Done — the CSE455 staff meeting is on my calendar for Tuesday 24 November, 15:00-15:30, and I've logged the change. See you all then. Thanks for coordinating with Sarah and Priya.
Thank you, John — see you Tuesday at 15:00.
